description: This file contains a unit test suite for the class DefaultExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It tests the conversion of various exceptions into acknowledgment messages, ensuring correct handling of null inputs, exception messages, causes, and specific exception types.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionToAcknowledgementConverterTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter, focusing on exception conversion to acknowledgment messages, singleton properties, and immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test headers and the instance of the converter before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the DefaultExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter class is immutable.

methods.name: getInstanceCreatesSingleton
methods.description: Checks that getInstance returns a singleton instance.

methods.name: convertExceptionWithNullException
methods.description: Tests that passing null as exception throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: convertExceptionWithNullLabel
methods.description: Tests that passing null as label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: convertExceptionWithNullEntityId
methods.description: Tests that passing null as entityId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: convertExceptionWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that passing null as dittoHeaders throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: convertGenericExceptionWithMessageWithoutCause
methods.description: Verifies conversion of a generic exception with a message and no cause into an acknowledgment.

methods.name: getGenericExceptionMessage
methods.description: Generates a standardized message string for an exception.

methods.name: convertGenericExceptionWithMessageWithCause
methods.description: Verifies conversion of a generic exception with message and cause into an acknowledgment.

methods.name: getGenericExceptionDescriptionWithCause
methods.description: Creates a description string that includes the cause's simple class name.

methods.name: convertGenericExceptionWithoutMessageWithoutCause
methods.description: Tests conversion for an exception without message or cause.

methods.name: convertGenericExceptionWithoutMessageWithCause
methods.description: Tests conversion of an exception with a cause but no message.

methods.name: convertDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Checks conversion of a specific Ditto ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException into an acknowledgement, ensuring status code is properly extracted.
